hooks.name: SlopSeal: block agent install commands
hooks.description: Before the agent runs a shell command, runs the slopseal.hooks.on_install module with the hook payload on stdin. A command with no install exits 0. For an install of pinned pip or npm packages (pip install name==x.y.z, npm install name@x.y.z, npx name@x.y.z), the module runs the SlopSeal verdict pipeline for each package. ALLOW for every package exits 0 and the command runs. BLOCK exits 2 with the failed check, the reason, and a suggested fix. QUARANTINE exits 2 with the check name and the next step. An install the hook cannot verify exits 2 with a fix: an unpinned or ranged version, a URL or path, -r, another package manager (uv, poetry, cargo, and others), an environment assignment or xargs before the install, or text it cannot parse. Fails closed: any error exits 2, and if slopseal cannot run (exit code other than 0 or 2), the wrapper prints an install hint and blocks the command with exit 2. Each verified package counts against the install rate limit. Installs the user runs go through the SlopSeal PATH shim, which verifies each package.

action.command: sh -c '"$1" -m slopseal.hooks.on_install; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: SlopSeal is not installed for \"$1\". Install it into that Python with: \"$1\" -m pip install git+https://github.com/mazi3012/SlopSeal.git" >&2; exit 2; else exit $rc; fi' sh python3
